name: SC7730SE kernel 4.9 (arm cross build)
//: Ubuntu 20.04 on purpose: its default cross toolchain is GCC 9, which still builds Linux 4.9. GCC 10+ changed -fno-common and produces link errors on this kernel.
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends bc bison flex libssl-dev libelf-dev gcc-arm-linux-gnueabihf device-tree-compiler ccache abootimg lz4 cpio kmod && arm-linux-gnueabihf-gcc --version | head -n 1
